data.description:
## Acceptance Criteria

- Impact ranges and categories documented per category (Income Boost, Reputation Boost, Cost Reduction, Incident Mitigation)
- Stacking constraints documented (max 1 income-boost + 1 reputation-boost per staff)
- Street-wide effects (e.g. Cost Cutter -15% ongoing) flagged for additional testing
- Full project test suite passes (npm test green)
- npm run build succeeds

## Implementation
- Add balance documentation (per-category impact ranges, stacking constraints) to Main Street docs / help text
- Flag street-wide effects for testing
- Run full test suite: npx vitest run --project unit + browser tests + tutorial E2E
- Run npm run build and fix any TS errors
- Coordinate with related work items (CG-0MSXOW6GN008ZSMN Town Gossip, CG-0MSQJ7VL9009JHF4 Group F, CG-0MSVYPEZ90085SHE ongoing costs)
data.title: Balance documentation & integration tests
